component.name: wayimg
component.summary: Image viewer for Wayland tiling window managers

description.p: wayimg is a lightweight image viewer for Wayland, built with SDL3 and designed to work well with tiling window managers.

ul.li: PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, QOI, TGA, PCX, PNM, XCF, XPM, LBM and simple SVG
